$comment: Expected secret and variable NAMES per GitHub environment (never values). Checked by scripts/ci/check-environment-settings.mjs; see docs/operations/environment-settings.md. shared: required in every environment. only: required in that environment alone, with the reason. pending: known drift that is tolerated (present or absent) until it is resolved; the check lists it on every run.

secrets.SENTRY_DSN_STAGING: Sentry DSNs are named per environment (deploy.yml, build-web-images.yml).
secrets.STAGING_PROBE_CREDENTIALS: Synthetic probe login through the staging gate; deploy.yml passes it on staging only.

variables.NOTIFICATIONS_EMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS: Staging email allowlist; render-env.py requires it on staging only.

secrets.SENTRY_DSN_PRODUCTION: Sentry DSNs are named per environment (deploy.yml, build-web-images.yml).

secrets.BACKUP_HEARTBEAT_URL: Staging only here: production's backup heartbeat is a secret of the production-backup environment, read by backup-database.yml.
secrets.ACCOUNT_SSO_CLIENT_SECRET: Account app SSO client (ADR-0057, issue #1335): staging first, production at go-live.
secrets.BETTERSTACK_API_TOKEN: Monitoring token on staging only; same decision as the heartbeats.
secrets.BOOKINGS_SSO_CLIENT_SECRET: Bookings SSO client exists on staging only (issue #1146).
